11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager having a slightly frustrating day is told they are very good at explaining things.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been having an ordinary, slightly frustrating day. Nothing terrible has happened, but everything seems to be taking longer than it should. Then (friend) casually remarks, "You know, you're very good at explaining things." (subject) is surprised. Nobody has ever said that before.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "You make difficult things easier to understand," (friend) explains. (subject) thinks about this for the rest of the afternoon. (subject.He/She) had always assumed everyone could do that.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: "Thank you," says (subject). The conversation moves on. Later, while washing (subject.his/her) hands, (subject) remembers the compliment and smiles. The day feels a little better.
